text:
Logan Stankoven has become one of the season's scoring surprises, and the headlines from The Hockey Writers and Heavy have caught up with him. He has 11 goals in 19 games after 21 all of last season, plus 12 points in his last ten and a five-game point streak. He's been skating between Jackson Blake and Nikolaj Ehlers.

Our verdict on the hot streak is that it's earned. He's getting more and better chances (5.2 expected goals on his own shots over the last ten games against 3.5 usual), and Carolina gets 63% of the expected goals at five on five with him on.

Some of the finish will fade. He's shooting 20% against 13% last season, and the team has scored 6.2 more goals than expected with him out there, so his point pace sits well above our range. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking explains why the chances are good: home-plate looks in the 91st percentile and clean zone exits. Watch the shot quality, not the goal count. That's what's changed, and it's the part that should stick.
headline: Stankoven's breakout is mostly earned
